what: On hover the background turns to the accent color and the text to the text color for use on the accent (.5s, small tags and pills .3s). Buttons, menus, tags and arrow buttons all react the same way, so they are grouped as one. In the ‹rise› type, instead of changing the background, a filled surface rises from bottom to top in .5s and the text color changes in .3s. In the ‹grow› type, a same-shaped surface starts at .6× from the center and grows to 1× opaque as it turns on (.3s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1))

options.--fx-fill: Background to switch to (via style), default var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-on: Text color that gets swapped, default var(--kf-on-accent)
options.look: ‹rise› — Fill type that rises from below (data-fx-fill-swap-hover="look: rise"). A gradient also works for --fx-fill · ‹rise-through› — same as rise, but on release the surface slides out upward (Brand card) · ‹grow› — a surface of the same shape starts at the center at .6x and transparent, then turns on to 1x (surface and text .3s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1), Brand pill and square buttons). To cover the border too, put the border width in --fx-edge
options.--fx-ease: Curve — default type is ease, the fill-up of the rise type uses cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)
options.--fx-text-dur: text color duration for the rise type, default .3s
options.--fx-press: Scale applied while hovered (via style), default none — Brand card · fixed button .95
options.--fx-text-ease: Text color (and press) curve for the rise type, default ease
options.--fx-from: Starting scale of a grow-type surface, default .6
options.--fx-edge: Thickness (via style) that widens a grow-type face beyond the border, default 0 — 2px when covering the border too
options.--fx-rest: Resting background of the grow-type fill (via style), default --fx-fill — if transparent, the fill background also fills in over .3s (street-illustration-fintech-landing header square button)
options.--fx-edge-on: Hover color of the border for the grow type, default currentColor (follows the text color) — the header square button uses --fx-fill
